topic: Constructing a Scale Model of the Solar System
key_concepts: The solar system has eight planets revolving around the Sun
The Sun is the center of the solar system
The Sun's gravity holds the planets in orbit
Inner terrestrial planets are Mercury, Venus, Earth, and Mars
Inner planets are closer to the Sun, smaller, rocky, dense, and lack rings
Outer Jovian planets are Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune
Outer planets are farther from the Sun, larger, mostly gaseous, and have rings
An astronomical unit is the average distance from Earth to the Sun
Earth is about 149,600,000 kilometers or 1 AU from the Sun
Planet distances from the Sun can be shown using AU and scaled model distances
Planet sizes can be compared using diameter and relative diameter
Jupiter is the largest planet in the solar system
